messages:
cust_acme_onboarding: Hey team — onboarding script started hitting 429s this morning while running integration tests. They say it was fine in the sandbox but once they ran a 10-min soak it tripled traffic and started getting throttles. Can we get a temporary lift or grace window?

support_ash: Sorry about that — can you paste the root request-id or an example response body? Which account/org id is this?

cust_acme_onboarding: org_9abc / request-id: req_20240319_7f3b. Here's the curl we ran:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ONBOARD-XXXX" \
  -d '{"model":"openlite-16k","input":"test user flow"}'
```

Response: 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","limit":1000,"window_seconds":60}

We were on a promo free onboarding token — not sure what limit maps to the promo.

support_ash: Thanks. Looks like this hit the free/onboarding tier cap — our promo keys map to the free-plan rate limit which is 1000 requests/min total across the org (we do per-org token bucket). For ramping onboarding tests we usually offer a short "grace window" or a temporary uplift. I can start ops flow but need a few approvals.

maria_sales: @support_ash fyi this account is in the final stage of a POC. If we can give a 24-hour soft lift to 5k req/min and $200 in extra credits they can complete the ingestion. I can own the commercial follow-up.

ops_luke: Quick heads-up on risk: bumping the token bucket for 24h is low-risk but we need to make sure it doesn't affect colocated tenants. I can patch the limiter for this org via internal flag `org_rate_override` and set a soft limit + alert. Will need an ops ticket & sign-off.

eng_jordan: If you're doing a big soak remember we have per-model per-worker concurrency knobs too — suggest lowering concurrency per client to avoid head-of-line effects. Also watch KV cache warm-up; lots of cold-state requests amplify token usage.

support_ash: Proposed plan:
1) Issue an Ops ticket (OPS-4809) to apply `org_rate_override: 5000` for org_9abc for 24 hours.
2) Add ephemeral alert channel so ops can observe token burn (we'll auto-revert).
3) Sales provides bridge credits and follow-up.

cust_acme_onboarding: That would be amazing. ETA? We need this window today, test starts at 10:30 PT.

ops_luke: I can run the change, but need explicit request email from sales or customer CSM for audit. @maria_sales can you get that? I can apply change in ~20–30m after ticket is created.

maria_sales: On it — emailing legal-approved note now and CCing support.

support-bot: OPS ticket OPS-4809 created by support_ash. Current status: awaiting ops triage.

ops_luke: Change applied: `org_rate_override=5000` for org_9abc; start=1791234700 end=1791321100; temporary alert channel #ops-temp-org_9abc. Monitor and report issues.

cust_acme_onboarding: Confirmed — soak ran, no more 429s. Thanks team! :party_parrot:

support_ash: Closing loop: I've documented the incident and flagged for billing to apply $200 onboarding credit and to ensure we convert to paid plan before lift expires. If anything regresses reopen OPS-4809.

maria_sales: Follow-up: user is happy, scheduling conversion call tomorrow. I will update CRM and attach audit log from OPS ticket.

eng_jordan: For future: recommend we add a short-term self-serve "onboarding burst" for new trial orgs (opt in via console) so we avoid manual ops flow. Filing RFC.

support_ash: Great idea. Filed RFC-1462 to explore automation and guardrails. Thanks all!
